scope: Function-level coefficient-control values used by manuscript Table 2

audited_generator_snapshot.relationship: Pre-metadata generator source audited against the retained artifact; this is not an immutable producing-environment receipt.

measurement.grid: 20,001 uniformly spaced points on each row's closed interval [-Lc, Lc]
measurement.current_coefficients: decimal literals parsed from the deployed CUDA header and evaluated directly without BF16 pre-rounding
measurement.sollya_coefficients: Sollya fpminimax coefficients constrained to 8-bit precision and cast to BF16 before host evaluation
measurement.intermediate_rounding: none; target-precision intermediate rounding is not replayed
measurement.device_measurement: not a device measurement; this is a host-side coefficient control

shared_comparison_controls: host evaluation grid and error metric
special_case: Both Swish-forward columns are composed from their corresponding sigmoid coefficient rows rather than fitted as independent Swish polynomials.

provenance_limitations.detail: The retained artifact contains no embedded command, source hashes, Sollya version, NumPy version, PyTorch version, or immutable producing-environment record. This sidecar records a source audit of the retained bytes.

review_required.required_review: Revise the Table 2 caption/method text or regenerate a symmetric coefficient comparison and update the table.
